description: This script generates default font family configurations for Chromium on different platforms by parsing locale resource files and mapping script names to font families.

classes.name: ScriptFontFamilies
classes.description: A class managing a mapping from script names to font families, with methods to set fonts and serialize to JSON.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets a font family for a given script and family name.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the font families mapping to a JSON-compatible object.
